title: TRACE: Training-Free Partial Audio Deepfake Detection via Embedding Trajectory Analysis of Speech Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.01083v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Partial audio deepfakes, where synthesized segments are spliced into genuine recordings, are particularly deceptive because most of the audio remains authentic. Existing detectors are supervised: they require frame-level annotations, overfit to specific synthesis pipelines, and must be retrained as new generative models emerge. We argue that this supervision is unnecessary. We hypothesize that speech foundation models implicitly encode a forensic signal: genuine speech forms smooth, slowly varying embedding trajectories, while splice boundaries introduce abrupt disruptions in frame-level transitions. Building on this, we propose TRACE (Training-free Representation-based Audio Countermeasure via Embedding dynamics), a training-free framework that detects partial audio deepfakes by analyzing the first-order dynamics of frozen speech foundation model representations without any training, labeled data, or architectural modification

translated_title: TRACE：基于语音基础模型嵌入轨迹分析的无训练部分音频深度伪造检测
translated_abstract: 部分音频深度伪造是指将合成的语音片段拼接进真实录音中，这类伪造极具欺骗性，因为音频的大部分内容仍然是真实的。现有的检测器都是有监督的：它们需要帧级标注，容易过拟合到特定的合成流程，并且每当新的生成模型出现时都必须重新训练。我们认为这种监督是不必要的。我们假设语音基础模型隐式地编码了取证信号：真实的语音会形成平滑、缓慢变化的嵌入轨迹，而拼接边界会在帧级过渡中引入突然的中断。基于这一假设，我们提出了TRACE（基于表示的无训练音频对抗方法——通过嵌入动力学实现），这是一个无需训练的框架，通过分析冻结的语音基础模型表示的一阶动力学来检测部分音频深度伪造，全程无需任何训练、标注数据或架构修改。
tldr: 提出无需训练的TRACE框架，通过分析冻结语音基础模型嵌入轨迹的一阶动力学来检测部分音频深度伪造——真实语音嵌入轨迹平滑缓慢变化，而拼接边界会引入突变。
en_tdlr: TRACE is a training-free framework that detects partial audio deepfakes by analyzing the first-order dynamics of frozen speech foundation model embedding trajectories, exploiting the fact that genuine speech forms smooth trajectories while splice boundaries introduce abrupt disruptions.
